title: Smoothness Errors in Dynamics Models and How to Avoid Them
abstract: arXiv:2602.05352v4 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Modern neural networks have shown promise for solving partial differential equations over surfaces, often by discretizing the surface as a mesh and learning with a mesh-aware graph neural network. However, graph neural networks suffer from oversmoothing, where a node's features become increasingly similar to those of its neighbors. Unitary graph convolutions, which are mathematically constrained to preserve smoothness, have been proposed to address this issue. Despite this, in many physical systems, such as diffusion processes, smoothness naturally increases and unitarity may be overconstraining. In this paper, we systematically study the smoothing effects of different GNNs for dynamics modeling and prove that unitary convolutions hurt performance for such tasks. translated_title: 动力学模型中的平滑性误差及其避免方法
translated_abstract: 现代神经网络在求解曲面上的偏微分方程方面展现出前景，通常的做法是将曲面离散化为网格，并使用网格感知的图神经网络进行学习。然而，图神经网络存在过度平滑问题，即节点的特征会变得与其邻居的特征越来越相似。幺正图卷积在数学上被约束为保持平滑性，已被提出用于解决这一问题。尽管如此，在许多物理系统（如扩散过程）中，平滑性会自然增加，幺正性约束可能过于严格。在本文中，我们系统地研究了不同图神经网络在动力学建模中的平滑效应，并证明了幺正卷积会损害此类任务的性能。我们提出了松弛幺正卷积，在保持平滑性与物理系统所需的自然平滑之间取得平衡。我们还对幺正卷积和松弛卷积进行了推广。
tldr: 本文系统研究了图神经网络在动力学建模中的过度平滑问题，证明了幺正卷积因过度约束平滑性而损害性能，并提出松弛幺正卷积以在平滑性保持与物理系统所需的自然平滑之间取得平衡。
en_tdlr: This paper systematically studies the oversmoothing effects of GNNs in dynamics modeling, proves that unitary convolutions hurt performance due to overconstrained smoothness, and proposes relaxed unitary convolutions to balance smoothness preservation with the natural smoothing required by physical systems.
